sn13.5:1.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso mahāpathaviyā satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhipeyya || ||
sn13.5:1.4: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ || yā vā satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā || yā vā mahāpathavīti || || 3
sn13.5:2.1: Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idaṃ mahāpathavī
sn13.5:2.3: neva satimam kalam upenti na sahassimam upenti na sasasahassimaṃ kalam upenti mahāpathavim upanidhāya satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittāti || || 4
